name: Data Broker Opt-Out Bot
tagline: Chases down the deletion requests that pull you off contact-data broker lists
description: This one walks the official removal channels at the big business-contact brokers such as Apollo and ZoomInfo, supplying the form, portal or email route each one expects. It also keeps a running tally of which requests have gone out and which brokers are still holding your details.
author: JackyHeshi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
